description: How many contacts match some segment rules, and how many of them a campaign to the main list would reach (subscribed and not suppressed), without saving anything. Rules use the same shape as list_segments’ `definition`: { match: "all" | "any", rules: [...] }, rule kinds field, stat, event, spent, list, added, engagement, emailed, consent (op inferred | not_inferred: subscribed on inferred consent as an existing customer, or not), topic. Field rules may test city, state and country, or whether a field is set (is_set, is_not_set); never names, emails or postcodes. Groups under 10 are "fewer than 10". Up to 200 counts a day per connection.
name: count_audience
title: Count an audience
